## Hosted Claude compatibility

- Supports hosted Claude custom connectors through Executor's existing HTTPS MCP endpoint and OAuth Dynamic Client Registration.
- Accepts only the exact Claude callback, `https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback`; other Claude paths, subdomains, ports and query strings remain rejected.
- Claude uses the public HTTPS endpoint with **Sign in now** and **Register automatically**. ChatGPT's optional OpenAI Tunnel is a separate entry to the same Hub and delegated devices.

## Desktop fixes

- Restores native MCP image/content blocks after Hub relay serialization, so screenshots reach the client as images.
- Sends macOS text through native Unicode keyboard events, fixing incorrect Chinese text produced by AppleScript keystrokes.
- Sends Windows drag movements with actual absolute physical coordinates and non-coalesced input, preserving held-button movement events.

## Verification and limits

Hosted Claude acceptance used Sonnet 5.5 Medium. Four-device status and owner file create/write/read checks passed with independent host SHA-256 verification. Pi5 pipe-mode argv terminal execution passed with exit code 0 and confirmed session close. macOS and Windows passed focus, screenshots, exact English/Chinese input, click, arrow key, drag and scroll checks; independent fixture and session checks agreed.

Pi5 and WSL had no graphical session in the reference deployment, so desktop capture remains unavailable there. One Mac relay interruption during acceptance recovered after reconnecting the relay service; its underlying cause remains unconfirmed.

Six macOS/Linux/Windows amd64/arm64 archives and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are published after native Go CI and Release CI pass for the exact tagged source. See the [source](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/tree/v0.4.1) and [connection instructions](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/blob/v0.4.1/README.md).

**Signing limits:** GitHub-built macOS apps are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Windows binaries are not Authenticode-signed. Publication does not reinstall or restart existing devices, migrate installations, or rotate credentials.
